name: Discord Threads
description: Create and control Discord threads Maxwell can work in.
author: Maxwell

prompt.text: To spin off focused work, create_thread with name= and context= (required). context= is injected into every turn in that thread so thread-you is not cold — put the goal, decisions so far, and what to do next. Use thread_control to add context, rename, archive, or list. Do not open a questionnaire thread; brief thread-you and work there.
